status: Local prospective freeze after synthetic/pinned contracts and fixed source directory metadata, before new inference or tracking; source-only downloads may still be ongoing. Prior diagnostic outcomes known; not external preregistration.

same_causal_rules.base: Confirmed selected weak row age>=2; same-column competitor score >= original weak gate and selected-minus-competitor <= unchanged .05. Active=confirmed and pre-update age1; retained/unconfirmed rows logged but cannot qualify.
same_causal_rules.past_support: Both hypotheses have nonempty recorded accepted-observation histories before this decision. On selected hypothesis last accepted observation strictly before decision, competitor must be in same stage, active confirmed, AND have its own distinct accepted observation; competitor score >= that stage original gate and signed gap <=.05. Check immutable keys. Missing comparison/observation is unknown, never filled or treated as proof of either identity. Birth keys unavailable; do not invent them. No native-ID joins, GT, future +1..+30 or fitted duration.
same_causal_rules.protection: Competitor currently has no other accepted weak update. Force it onto selected column and solve remaining unfiltered one-to-one assignment with original gate afterwards: every OTHER original accepted row/detection pair must remain and accepted count must not decrease. Selected missed-row update deliberately excluded; its deferral is tested as a harm. No opportunity-cost cutoff/equality requirement; solver-returned alternative only.
same_causal_rules.action: Four factorial arms: no veto, past support alone, protection alone, conjunction on SAME competitor. Any qualifying competitor vetoes the selected edge once. Decisions simultaneous from unmodified original matching. Only remove selected edge, return its row/column unmatched; never install alternative or rematch. Weak input unchanged and deferred detection remains upstream output ID -1.
same_causal_rules.history: Each arm owns its causal accepted-edge history; after decisions record only actually accepted high/weak observations (frame, original detection index). Strong object references prevent ownership reuse. No reference-history transfer after divergence.
same_causal_rules.unchanged: Weak detections/continuation, births, lifecycle, activation .3/high .6/buffer30/confirmation2, YOLO26n 8.4.176 CPU confidence .1/imgsz640/person0/max_det64/NMS.7/weight hash, source FPS10, app/worker/defaults. Buffer30 is 3 s at source10Hz, not previous 30Hz timing.

selection.order: All sixteen prior MOT exposure sources in original frozen order, now discovery-only. First two remaining KITTI training IDs in lexical order after previously studied0000–0003 reserved before any new source output. No post-output additions, replacements or early stop. Current KITTI0000–0003 negatives retained as prior study, excluded from this new scan. All other KITTI IDs excluded prospectively.
selection.eligibility: Per treatment independently: first completed full discovery source in fixed order with >=1 actual veto and >=1 veto frame on its own continuous history; three canonical/full-trace/count repeats equal, unhooked reference equal and zero detection-cap frames. No reference opportunities or per-frame favourable selection. Inspect every scheduled source even after a choice.
selection.failures: Keep all zero/failed sources with safe reason codes; local full exceptions. Failed source is unknown, not zero. Select first qualifying completed source but mark search incomplete; any discovery or reserved failure blocks replication. No retries, replacements or count/threshold loosening from outcomes.
selection.separation: Complete and seal ordered discovery ledger/hash/selections before any reserved detector or tracker output. Build separate hashed confirmation input lock only afterwards; reserve both full sources regardless discovery selection. No reserved scene may fill a discovery slot.
selection.confirmation_gate: Each treatment requires a discovery selection, every scheduled discovery and reserved source completed, and >=1 actual own-arm veto in BOTH reserved full sources with equal three repeats/unhooked references/zero cap frames. Otherwise false; no-exposure discovery selection remains null. This confirms mechanism exposure only, never accuracy/physical identity/quality or release acceptance.
selection.forbidden: No GT/labels/evaluator/FP/FN/IDSW/Identity/HOTA or accuracy ranking. No new parameters, windows, frame sampling, source substitution or defaults. Existing known GT outcomes not input features; no newly loaded scores.
selection.independence: Reserved KITTI IDs unseen to this project and separate dataset/source-family from prior MOT discovery. Shared pretrained model/runtime, non-random source group and two vehicle sequences do not establish independent sites/participants or statistical power. Current KITTI0000–0003 are already seen and excluded prospectively; prior negative record retained.

execution.inputs: Phase-local strict schema accepts only full source video/cache paths and hashes; no GT/evaluator/score keys at any level. Per-source input integrity failure remains in ledger. All original source frames, unchanged cache limits, continuous tracker/observation ownership across shards.
execution.history: Fresh tracker/control/probe per source/arm/repeat; independent per-arm accepted observation histories, no cross-ID joins or transferred reference history. Source processes isolated; OpenCV one thread/seed0; rotated arm order. Additional unhooked references. No throughput claim.
execution.source_timing: MOT original compressed previews retain original source FPS. KITTI originals lossless FFV1 BGR/pixel-verified10Hz. Buffer30 unchanged: nominal1–1.2s on MOT versus3s on KITTI; no FPS normalisation or tuning.
execution.weak_continuation: Original weak inputs, active weak continuation, uncontested recovery, upstream activation/high/buffer/confirmation, same causal rule and app/worker defaults unchanged.
